evidence.section: 2.1. Preparation of the as-cast alloy and pre-alloyed powders
evidence.quote: Ingots weighing 100 g of Al1Ti5Zr4Nb3Ta3 were fabricated in the vacuum arc-melting furnace under an argon atmosphere. Commercially pure metallic ingredients (the purity of metal elements: 99.99 wt%) were used as raw materials.

evidence.section: 2.1. Preparation of the as-cast alloy and pre-alloyed powders
evidence.quote: Powders with different sizes in a range of 53 120 μ m was prepared using the plasma rotating electrode process (PREP)

the moderate laser power P = 1400 W and laser scanning rate V = 500 mm/s (No.5, indicated by green box) are sufficient to obtain perfect molten pool morphology with the track height ( Δ h ) of 0.36 mm and the track width ( Δ x ) of 5 mm
the analyses of the XRD indicate that the powder is constituted of two BCC structure phases, namely BCC1 and BCC2, as evidenced by the splitting in diffraction peaks of the BCC phase

evidence.section: 3.2. The microstructures of the LMD-fabricated and as-cast alloys
evidence.quote: the cuboidal BCC nanoparticles (indicated by the white arrow) with a radius of r ~ 3.5 nm precipitated in the B2 matrix, as shown in Fig. 6 (b, c), where the cuboidal BCC nanoparticles and B2 matrix are with the volume fraction of f ~ 65.1 % and f ~ 34.9 %, respectively.

evidence.section: 3.2. The microstructures of the LMD-fabricated and as-cast alloys
evidence.quote: The DF images and corresponding SAED patterns exhibit spherical B2 nanoparticles (nanocluster) with a size of 1 2 nm are dispersedly precipitated in the BCC matrix

attributes.size: average 38 μm; VB 31±13, VM 39±15, VT 45±17 μm

evidence.section: 3.2. The microstructures of the LMD-fabricated and as-cast alloys
evidence.quote: It is evident that the fine equiaxed grains were uniformly distributed from bottom layers to top layers along the deposition direction. The corresponding grain size ( d ) were measured to be dVB = 31 ± 13 μ m, dVM = 39 ± 15 μ m, and dVT = 45 ± 17 μ m, respectively, and the average grain size of the LMD-fabricated alloy was measured to be 38 μ m.

evidence.section: 3.2. The microstructures of the LMD-fabricated and as-cast alloys
evidence.quote: By contrast, the as-cast alloy exhibits coarse equiaxed grains with the grain size of 206 μ m, as shown in Fig. 3 (d).

attributes.morphology: bright equiaxed dendrite phases in dark interdendrite phases

evidence.section: 3.2. The microstructures of the LMD-fabricated and as-cast alloys
evidence.quote: The further microstructure characterization results of the molten pool in the LMD-fabricated alloy reveal that the epitaxially grown bright equiaxed dendrite phases are uniformly distributed into the dark interdendrite phases

evidence.section: 4.3. The differences in mechanical properties across the deposition layers
evidence.quote: the dynamic thermal cycling during the deposition of subsequent layers causes the accumulation of thermal stresses in former layers, thereby significant residual stress in the bottom layers
